answer: I ran the 3-qubit GHZ circuit on sirius:mock with 200 shots. The circuit was H on qubit 0, CNOT 0 to 1, CNOT 1 to 2, and a measurement of all 3 qubits. The mock backend gave all-zero results, so these counts do not show entanglement. The job ran on a free mock backend, so it used no credits.
